scenario.name: Wyrmling Lair
scenario.description: Tier 2 5e 2024 (SRD 5.2) boss encounter: four Level 5 adventurers (Fighter, Wizard, Cleric, Rogue) battle a Red Dragon Wyrmling, two Cinder Hounds (one held back), and an Ember Magmin—all fire-immune—testing damage-immunity awareness, breath-weapon spacing, Bless + Shield economy, Vex + Nick mastery combos, and multi-round focus fire.

actions.rationale: Close to melee with the Ember Magmin (15 ft away; I'm using coordinates as feet, which matches the listed distances). From here I can take it with a Vex shortsword hit and a Nick dagger follow-up. This square stays out of the wyrmling's and hound's melee reach.
actions.table_talk: Taking out the Magmin. Careful, it bursts into fire when it dies, so stay 10 ft clear of it. Spread out against the dragon's breath cone.
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper moves 10 ft to (20, 20).

actions.rationale: The Magmin is in reach. A shortsword hit triggers Vex, giving advantage on my follow-up Nick dagger attack, which enables Sneak Attack even with no ally adjacent. The damage is piercing, so its fire immunity doesn't matter.
actions.table_talk: Engaging the Magmin. Keep clear of its death burst and stay spread out for the breath.
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper hits Ember Magmin with Shortsword (25 vs AC 14) for 9 piercing damage.
Vex mastery grants Kaelen Whisper Advantage on the next attack against Ember Magmin.

actions.rationale: The bonus-action off-hand dagger attack is light, and the Vex mark from my shortsword hit gives it Advantage. That should enable Sneak Attack on the bloodied Magmin and likely finish it this turn.
actions.table_talk: Finishing the Magmin now. Stay 10 ft clear of it in case it bursts!
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper hits Ember Magmin with Dagger (20 vs AC 14) for 3 piercing damage.

actions.rationale: I already used my Nick extra attack this turn, so another off-hand swing would be rejected again. My action is spent. Backing out of reach would provoke an Opportunity Attack from the Magmin, and the engine shows no safe Cunning Action option. The safest legal choice is to end my turn and let allies finish the critically wounded Magmin from range.
actions.table_talk: Magmin is nearly dead. Finish it from range and stay 10 ft clear when it bursts!
narrative_hooks: Round 1: Cinder Hound's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Repositioning to catch 2 target(s) in Fire Breath cone.
narrative_hooks: Cinder Hound moves 15 ft to (10, 15).

actions.rationale: Unleashing Fire Breath against 2 target(s).
narrative_hooks: Dorian Dawnshield fails against Cinder Hound's Fire Breath (DC 12) and takes 25 damage.
Lyra Starweave saves against Cinder Hound's Fire Breath (DC 12) and takes 12 damage.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 1: Red Dragon Wyrmling's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Repositioning to catch 2 target(s) in Fire Breath cone.
narrative_hooks: Red Dragon Wyrmling moves 20 ft to (10, 15).

actions.rationale: Unleashing Fire Breath against 2 target(s).
narrative_hooks: Dorian Dawnshield fails against Red Dragon Wyrmling's Fire Breath (DC 13) and takes 17 damage.
Lyra Starweave saves against Red Dragon Wyrmling's Fire Breath (DC 13) and takes 8 damage.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 1: Ember Magmin's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Attacking Kaelen Whisper in melee with Touch.
narrative_hooks: Ember Magmin misses Kaelen Whisper with Touch (6 vs AC 16).

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 1: Dorian Dawnshield's turn begins.

actions.rationale: I'm at 1 HP next to the hound and the wyrmling, and Lyra is badly burned too. Mass Healing Word as a bonus action heals us both. I'll still have my action to Disengage and pull back out of melee so an opportunity attack doesn't drop me.
actions.table_talk: Patching me and Lyra up. Lyra, spread away from me so one breath cone can't catch us both again. Remember they're all fire-immune, so no fire spells.
narrative_hooks: Dorian Dawnshield casts Mass Healing Word, restoring 10 HP to Dorian Dawnshield.
Dorian Dawnshield casts Mass Healing Word, restoring 10 HP to Lyra Starweave.

actions.rationale: The hound and the wyrmling are both adjacent to me. Spirit Guardians deals radiant damage, which they aren't immune to, at the start of each of their turns. It also halves their speed, so it should outdamage a mace swing. Allies are excluded from the aura. It uses my last 3rd-level slot, and at 11 HP my concentration is fragile, but it triggers before they act.
actions.table_talk: Spirit Guardians is up. Radiant spirits around me will chew on the hound and the dragon. Aldric, Kaelen, focus the wyrmling. I'm low, so a Shield from Lyra or a heal would help if I drop.
narrative_hooks: Dorian Dawnshield casts Spirit Guardians; no other creature is in its area.

actions.rationale: My action and bonus action are spent. At 11 HP, moving out of reach of the hound or the wyrmling would provoke Opportunity Attacks that could drop me. Both enemies are already inside my Spirit Guardians aura, so I'll stay put and keep it running.
actions.table_talk: Holding position. The hound and the wyrmling are cooking in my Spirit Guardians. Aldric, Kaelen, hit the wyrmling hard. I'm at 11 HP, so I could use some cover.
narrative_hooks: Round 1: Aldric Vance's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Closing 10 ft to get within melee reach of the wyrmling, beside Dorian, so I can use my attacks on it next. This keeps the boss tied up while Spirit Guardians grinds it and the hound.
actions.table_talk: Moving in on the wyrmling. Dorian, I'm on your flank to soak hits.
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance moves 10 ft to (5, 10).

actions.rationale: The wyrmling is the boss and in reach. Longsword slashing damage isn't blocked by its fire immunity, and Sap gives it disadvantage on its next attack, which protects Dorian at 11 HP.
actions.table_talk: On the wyrmling! Sapping it so its next swing is off. Dorian, stay close to me.
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance hits Red Dragon Wyrmling with Longsword (21 vs AC 17) for 12 slashing damage.
Sap mastery gives Red Dragon Wyrmling Disadvantage on its next attack roll.

actions.rationale: The wyrmling already has Sap's Disadvantage, so a second Sap won't stack. My Extra Attack goes to the Greatsword for more damage, and Graze still deals damage on a miss. This keeps focus fire on the boss.
actions.table_talk: Wyrmling's sapped. Piling on with the greatsword. Keep hitting it with non-fire damage!
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance hits Red Dragon Wyrmling with Greatsword (23 vs AC 17) for 12 slashing damage.

actions.rationale: Action and both attacks are spent. No bonus actions are available, and I'm at full HP so Second Wind isn't needed. Moving off would provoke Opportunity Attacks and leave Dorian exposed, so I hold position adjacent to the sapped wyrmling and the hound.
actions.table_talk: Wyrmling took 24 from me and is sapped. I'm holding the line next to Dorian. Keep the non-fire damage on the dragon!
narrative_hooks: Round 1: Lyra Starweave's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Every enemy is fire-immune, so I'm using force damage. Magic Missile auto-hits, so one dart should finish the critical Magmin and two go into the wyrmling. Shatter or Lightning Bolt here would likely catch Dorian (11 HP) and Aldric, who are next to the targets. I'll reposition afterward to spread out from the breath.
actions.table_talk: Force darts incoming. One finishes the Magmin, two into the wyrmling. Kaelen, the Magmin should burst right after, so brace for the fire.
narrative_hooks: Lyra Starweave casts Magic Missile at Ember Magmin for 2 force damage.
Lyra Starweave casts Magic Missile at Red Dragon Wyrmling for 9 force damage.
Ember Magmin drops to 0 HP and is defeated.
Ember Magmin explodes in a 10-ft burst!

actions.rationale: My action is spent, and I cast a slotted spell this turn, so Misty Step isn't an option. I'll use my movement to step 20 ft away from the wyrmling and the hound. That puts me outside their 15-ft breath cones and spreads me away from Dorian so one cone can't catch us both.
actions.table_talk: Backing off to spread out from Dorian against the breath. Wyrmling took 9 force from me, so keep pressing it with non-fire damage!
narrative_hooks: Lyra Starweave moves 10 ft to (0, 35).

actions.rationale: My action is spent. I'm using 10 ft of movement to get 30 ft from the wyrmling and Dorian. That keeps me out of breath-cone range of everyone and spread from the cleric. Misty Step stays in reserve as an escape.
actions.table_talk: Pulling back to stay out of breath range. I'll keep force and cold damage on the wyrmling next round. No fire!
narrative_hooks: Lyra Starweave moves 10 ft to (0, 45).

actions.rationale: My action is spent. At (0,45) I'm 30 ft from the wyrmling and its hound, well outside a 15-ft breath cone, and 50 ft from Hound B. Misty Step would only burn a slot, so I'll hold here and keep the wyrmling within Ray of Frost and spell range for next round.
actions.table_talk: I'm spread out and clear of breath range. Next round I'm putting cold and force on the wyrmling. Dorian, shout if you drop and I'll come back for you.
narrative_hooks: Round 1: Cinder Hound B's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Repositioning to catch 2 target(s) in Fire Breath cone.
narrative_hooks: Cinder Hound B moves 40 ft to (10, 15).

actions.rationale: Unleashing Fire Breath against 2 target(s).
narrative_hooks: Dorian Dawnshield saves against Cinder Hound B's Fire Breath (DC 12) and takes 7 damage.
Aldric Vance saves against Cinder Hound B's Fire Breath (DC 12) and takes 7 damage.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 2: Kaelen Whisper's turn begins.

actions.rationale: I'm closing to 5 ft of the wyrmling at (10,15). No enemy currently reaches me, so the move is free. Aldric and Dorian are already adjacent to it, which gives me Sneak Attack. Next I'll hit it with a Vex shortsword strike, then a Nick dagger attack, all piercing, which the fire immunity doesn't block.
actions.table_talk: Flanking the wyrmling now. Piercing steel incoming, no fire. Dorian, hang on!
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper moves 5 ft to (15, 20).

actions.rationale: The wyrmling is in reach and Aldric is adjacent to it, so Sneak Attack should apply. The shortsword's Vex mastery sets up advantage, and I can follow with a Nick dagger attack. Piercing damage avoids its fire immunity.
actions.table_talk: Shortsword into the wyrmling with Sneak Attack, Aldric. Vex gives me advantage on the follow-up. Dagger next!
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper hits Red Dragon Wyrmling with Shortsword (19 vs AC 17) for 10 piercing damage.
Vex mastery grants Kaelen Whisper Advantage on the next attack against Red Dragon Wyrmling.

actions.rationale: I still have my bonus action, so I'm making the off-hand dagger strike. Vex gives me Advantage on the bloodied wyrmling. The damage is piercing, so its fire immunity doesn't matter, and this keeps the focus fire on the boss.
actions.table_talk: Dagger follow-up into the wyrmling with Advantage. It's bloodied, so keep piling on, everyone!
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper misses Red Dragon Wyrmling with Dagger (15 vs AC 17).

actions.rationale: My action is spent and my Nick extra attack is used. The offhand bonus attack is rejected, and Cunning Action isn't offered in legal_actions. Moving away would provoke three opportunity attacks. From (15,20) I'm on the opposite side of the enemy cluster from Dorian, so no single cone breath can catch us both. I'll hold here with my reaction ready for Uncanny Dodge.
actions.table_talk: I'm holding the southeast flank, opposite Dorian, so the wyrmling can't breathe on both of us. Lyra, put force or cold on it. It's bloodied, so finish it!
narrative_hooks: Round 2: Cinder Hound's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Attacking Dorian Dawnshield in melee with Multiattack.
narrative_hooks: Cinder Hound hits Dorian Dawnshield with Bite (20 vs AC 16) for 11 damage.
Dorian Dawnshield drops to 0 HP and falls Unconscious and Prone.
Dorian Dawnshield loses concentration on spirit-guardians (dropped_to_0_hp).
Cinder Hound hits Dorian Dawnshield with Bite (CRITICAL HIT!) (24 vs AC 16) for 17 damage.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 2: Red Dragon Wyrmling's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Unleashing Fire Breath against 1 target(s).
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper fails against Red Dragon Wyrmling's Fire Breath (DC 13) and takes 21 damage.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 2: Dorian Dawnshield's turn begins.
Dorian Dawnshield fails a Death Save (2) and dies.

actions.rationale: Auto-skipped (incapacitated or 0 HP).
narrative_hooks: Round 2: Aldric Vance's turn begins.

actions.rationale: The wyrmling is bloodied and within reach, so it is the priority kill. The greatsword does the most damage, and Graze still deals damage on a miss. Slashing is not affected by its fire immunity. Dorian is dead, so there is no one to revive, and I'll focus fire with Extra Attack.
actions.table_talk: Dorian's gone. Make it count! Greatsword on the bloodied wyrmling. Kaelen, stay spread out, and Lyra, force or cold on it!
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance hits Red Dragon Wyrmling with Greatsword (19 vs AC 17) for 6 slashing damage.

actions.rationale: I still have my Extra Attack. I'm keeping focus fire on the bloodied wyrmling with the greatsword: slashing damage it doesn't resist, and Graze still deals damage if I miss.
actions.table_talk: Second swing on the wyrmling. It's bloodied, so keep the non-fire damage coming and we drop it this round!
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance misses Red Dragon Wyrmling with Greatsword (13 vs AC 17).
Graze mastery still deals 4 slashing damage to Red Dragon Wyrmling.

actions.rationale: My action and attacks are spent, no bonus actions are listed, and Dorian is dead, so there is no one to revive. A Heroic Inspiration reroll is flagged, but it isn't one of the allowed intent schemas, so I won't risk an illegal intent. Moving away would provoke opportunity attacks from three enemies in reach, so I hold position and end my turn.
actions.table_talk: Graze got 4 more onto the wyrmling. I'm holding the line here. Kaelen, Lyra: non-fire damage on the bloodied wyrmling to finish it!
narrative_hooks: Round 2: Lyra Starweave's turn begins.

actions.rationale: The wyrmling is bloodied and has taken heavy damage this round. A 3rd-level Magic Missile puts five auto-hitting force darts on it (5d4+5, minimum 10), which is the most reliable way to finish it. Force gets around its fire immunity, needs no save, and avoids aiming a line AoE near Aldric and Kaelen. I stay well out of breath and bite range.
actions.table_talk: Five force darts into the wyrmling, all of them! Aldric, Kaelen, if it's still standing, hit it again, then we turn on the hounds.
narrative_hooks: Lyra Starweave casts Magic Missile at Red Dragon Wyrmling for 18 force damage.

actions.rationale: My action is spent on Magic Missile, and having expended a slot this turn rules out Misty Step. I'll use my remaining 30 ft to back away to 60 ft from the enemy cluster. That keeps me out of the wyrmling's 30-ft move plus its 15-ft breath cone, and spread from Kaelen.
actions.table_talk: I'm out of actions this turn, so I'm falling back to stay clear of the breath. Aldric, Kaelen, finish the wyrmling. It's on its last legs!
narrative_hooks: Lyra Starweave moves 30 ft to (0, 75).

actions.rationale: My action and movement are spent. Misty Step would burn a slot for nothing, and I already cast a leveled spell this turn. At 60 ft I'm clear of the breath but still in range for Ray of Frost or Magic Missile next round.
actions.table_talk: Holding back here at range. If the wyrmling's still up next round it eats cold or force from me; otherwise I'm switching to the hounds. No fire on any of them!
narrative_hooks: Round 2: Cinder Hound B's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Unleashing Fire Breath against 1 target(s).
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper saves against Cinder Hound B's Fire Breath (DC 12) and takes 7 damage.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 3: Kaelen Whisper's turn begins.

actions.rationale: The wyrmling is at critical HP and Aldric is adjacent to it, so I get Sneak Attack. A piercing shortsword hit with Sneak Attack should finish it. Vex sets up the dagger Nick follow-up if it somehow survives.
actions.table_talk: Wyrmling's almost done. Sneak Attack shortsword to finish it! I'm at 5 HP, so Aldric, keep those hounds busy.
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper misses Red Dragon Wyrmling with Shortsword (11 vs AC 17).

actions.rationale: My action is spent, but the light-weapon bonus attack is still open. The wyrmling is at critical HP and doesn't resist piercing, so a dagger off-hand strike could finish the biggest threat now.
actions.table_talk: Dagger off-hand into the wyrmling. Drop, you overgrown lizard! Aldric, the hounds are next.
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper hits Red Dragon Wyrmling with Dagger (18 vs AC 17) for 2 piercing damage.

actions.rationale: My action and Nick attack are both spent, and the bonus-action off-hand attack was already rejected. At 5 HP, moving out of reach would provoke opportunity attacks from up to three enemies, so I'll hold position and end my turn.
actions.table_talk: I'm tapped out and barely standing. Aldric, Lyra, the wyrmling is critical, so finish it before its breath recharges!
narrative_hooks: Round 3: Cinder Hound's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Unleashing Fire Breath against 1 target(s).
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper fails against Cinder Hound's Fire Breath (DC 12) and takes 23 damage.
Kaelen Whisper drops to 0 HP and falls Unconscious and Prone.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 3: Red Dragon Wyrmling's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Attacking Aldric Vance in melee with Multiattack.
narrative_hooks: Red Dragon Wyrmling hits Aldric Vance with Rend (21 vs AC 19) for 11 damage.
Red Dragon Wyrmling misses Aldric Vance with Rend (10 vs AC 19).

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 3: Aldric Vance's turn begins.

actions.rationale: The wyrmling is critical and within reach. A greatsword swing deals slashing damage, which it isn't immune to, and Graze still lands damage on a miss. Dropping it now removes its breath weapon before it recharges. I have no healing to revive Kaelen, so killing the threat comes first.
actions.table_talk: Wyrmling's on its last breath, and I'm finishing it! Lyra, after this, get to Kaelen or cover him from those hounds.
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance misses Red Dragon Wyrmling with Greatsword (11 vs AC 17).
Graze mastery still deals 4 slashing damage to Red Dragon Wyrmling.
Red Dragon Wyrmling drops to 0 HP and is defeated.

actions.rationale: Wyrmling is down. I'll use my remaining Extra Attack on the hound that just breathed on Kaelen. Longsword Sap gives it Disadvantage on its next attack, which protects me and the downed Kaelen. Slashing damage is fine since it is only immune to fire.
actions.table_talk: Wyrmling's dead! I'm on the hounds now and sapping this one so it fumbles its next bite. Lyra, Kaelen is down at 15,20. Get him up or cover him, and no fire on these dogs!
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance hits Cinder Hound with Longsword (18 vs AC 15) for 11 slashing damage.
Sap mastery gives Cinder Hound Disadvantage on its next attack roll.

actions.rationale: My action and attacks are spent and no bonus action is available. Moving would draw opportunity attacks from both hounds, so I hold position and keep them engaged on me instead of the downed allies.
actions.table_talk: I'm tapped out but holding these hounds here. The first one is sapped. Lyra, Kaelen's down at 15,20. Get him up if you can, and no fire on these dogs!
narrative_hooks: Round 3: Lyra Starweave's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Both hounds are fire-immune. AoE like Shatter or Lightning Bolt would catch Aldric or downed Kaelen, and I have no healing. Auto-hit force darts on the already-wounded, sapped hound focus fire it down safely from range.
actions.table_talk: I can't heal Kaelen, so I'm doing the next best thing: four force darts into the sapped hound. Aldric, let's drop that one fast before it breathes on Kaelen again!
narrative_hooks: Lyra Starweave casts Magic Missile at Cinder Hound for 16 force damage.

actions.rationale: My action is spent on Magic Missile, and I have no healing to get Kaelen up. Misty Step and moving closer gain nothing, since I'm already within spell range of the hounds. Staying 60 ft back keeps me out of their fire breath cones.
actions.table_talk: That's 16 force into the sapped hound. Aldric, finish it! I can't heal Kaelen, so keep the dogs focused on you and off him. I'll keep blasting from range, and no fire.
narrative_hooks: Round 3: Cinder Hound B's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Attacking Aldric Vance in melee with Multiattack.
narrative_hooks: Cinder Hound B misses Aldric Vance with Bite (12 vs AC 19).
Cinder Hound B hits Aldric Vance with Bite (CRITICAL HIT!) (25 vs AC 19) for 24 damage.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 4: Kaelen Whisper's turn begins.
Kaelen Whisper rolls a Natural 20 on Death Save, regains 1 HP, and wakes Prone!

actions.rationale: I'm at 1 HP, prone, and can't stand because I have no movement left. Attacking from prone means Disadvantage, which also rules out Sneak Attack, so my damage would be poor. Dodge cancels the hounds' prone Advantage on their bites and gives me Advantage on Dex saves against their fire breath. That gives me the best odds of staying conscious until Lyra and Aldric bring the hounds down.
actions.table_talk: I'm back up at 1 HP but stuck prone, so I'm turtling. Aldric, Lyra, keep pounding the sapped hound. It's taken 27 already!
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper takes the Dodge action.

actions.rationale: Action is spent on Dodge, I have no movement left to stand, and I took no Attack action with a light weapon, so an off-hand attack isn't valid. At 1 HP and prone, keeping Dodge up and passing is the safest play.
actions.table_talk: I'm turtled at 1 HP. Aldric, Lyra, drop the sapped hound first. It's badly hurt. Nobody use fire!
narrative_hooks: Round 4: Cinder Hound's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Attacking Kaelen Whisper in melee with Multiattack.
narrative_hooks: Cinder Hound hits Kaelen Whisper with Bite (16 vs AC 16) for 7 damage.
Kaelen Whisper drops to 0 HP and falls Unconscious and Prone.
Cinder Hound hits Kaelen Whisper with Bite (CRITICAL HIT!) (24 vs AC 16) for 24 damage.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 4: Aldric Vance's turn begins.

actions.rationale: I'm at 2 HP, so a Dodge only delays things while both hounds keep mauling the downed Kaelen. The best play is to focus the already-damaged hound and try to drop it. The greatsword's Graze mastery guarantees damage even on a miss, and Heroic Inspiration is still available for a reroll.
actions.table_talk: I'm at 2 HP and going all in on the hurt hound with the greatsword. Lyra, hit that same dog with force damage, no fire! Kaelen's down again, so we have to thin these hounds now.
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance hits Cinder Hound with Greatsword (24 vs AC 15) for 9 slashing damage.

actions.rationale: I'm using my Extra Attack on the bloodied hound to keep the damage focused. If I miss, Graze still guarantees 4 damage, which brings it closer to dropping before it can maul Kaelen again.
actions.table_talk: Second swing into the bloodied hound! Lyra, pour force into it. It's close to dropping, and Kaelen can't take another round of bites.
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance hits Cinder Hound with Greatsword (16 vs AC 15) for 10 slashing damage.

actions.rationale: My action is spent and no bonus actions are listed. At 2 HP with both hounds adjacent, moving away would provoke two Opportunity Attacks. I can't stabilize Kaelen, so I'll hold position to keep the hounds' attention on me and off the downed rogue.
actions.table_talk: Hound one is nearly dead after two greatsword hits. Lyra, finish it with force damage, no fire! I'm at 2 HP holding both dogs here. Kaelen's down again and needs help fast.
narrative_hooks: Round 4: Lyra Starweave's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Hound B sits on the diagonal between downed Kaelen (15,20) and Aldric (5,10). From (10,45), a Lightning Bolt aimed straight down the x=10 column hits the hound but stays clear of both allies' squares. Moving closer may also pull the hound off the unconscious allies and onto me, and I still have Shield as a reaction.
actions.table_talk: Hang on, both of you! I'm lining up a lightning bolt on that dog that won't touch you, and drawing it my way. No fire!
narrative_hooks: Lyra Starweave moves 30 ft to (10, 45).

actions.rationale: The bolt runs straight north along x=10 to the hound at (10,15). Kaelen (15,20) and Aldric (5,10) are both off that 5-ft-wide line, so neither gets hit. Lightning isn't one of the hound's immunities, and 8d6 is my biggest damage while both allies sit at 0 HP. Staying 30 ft away keeps the hound coming toward me instead of finishing the downed allies.
actions.table_talk: Lightning bolt straight down the middle at the dog. Kaelen, Aldric, you're clear of the line. Come get me, mutt!
narrative_hooks: Lyra Starweave casts Lightning Bolt (DC 15 DEX): Cinder Hound B succeeds and takes 11 lightning damage.

actions.rationale: Action and movement are spent. Misty Step would waste my last 2nd-level slot, and putting more distance between me and the hound could send it back to finish my downed allies. Staying 30 ft away keeps me the most tempting target, and Shield is ready as a reaction.
actions.table_talk: Stay down and keep making those saves. I'm the bait now. Next turn more force and lightning go into that dog, no fire!

actions.rationale: I'm alone at 9 HP with the fire-immune hound adjacent. Magic Missile with my only 2nd-level slot sends four auto-hitting force darts (about 14 damage) and never misses. Staying put avoids an Opportunity Attack from moving away, and casting it on a ranged spell in melee has no attack-roll penalty because it doesn't roll. That leaves three 1st-level slots for automatic Shield reactions against its bites.
actions.table_talk: Four force darts into the dog! Aldric, hang on. I'll keep it on me, no fire!
narrative_hooks: Lyra Starweave casts Magic Missile at Cinder Hound B for 12 force damage.

actions.rationale: My action is spent on Magic Missile, and the off-hand attack isn't valid because I haven't made a Light-weapon attack this turn. Moving away would provoke an Opportunity Attack at 9 HP, and the hound would just follow me anyway. Staying put keeps Shield ready as my automatic reaction.
actions.table_talk: Aldric, hold on! The dog's taking force every turn and I'm keeping it on me. No fire!

Finishing the Magmin now. Stay 10 ft clear of it in case it bursts!
Magmin is nearly dead. Finish it from range and stay 10 ft clear when it bursts!
Patching me and Lyra up. Lyra, spread away from me so one breath cone can't catch us both again. Remember they're all fire-immune, so no fire spells.
Spirit Guardians is up. Radiant spirits around me will chew on the hound and the dragon. Aldric, Kaelen, focus the wyrmling. I'm low, so a Shield from Lyra or a heal would help if I drop.
Holding position. The hound and the wyrmling are cooking in my Spirit Guardians. Aldric, Kaelen, hit the wyrmling hard. I'm at 11 HP, so I could use some cover.
Moving in on the wyrmling. Dorian, I'm on your flank to soak hits.
On the wyrmling! Sapping it so its next swing is off. Dorian, stay close to me.
Wyrmling's sapped. Piling on with the greatsword. Keep hitting it with non-fire damage!
Wyrmling took 24 from me and is sapped. I'm holding the line next to Dorian. Keep the non-fire damage on the dragon!
Force darts incoming. One finishes the Magmin, two into the wyrmling. Kaelen, the Magmin should burst right after, so brace for the fire.
Backing off to spread out from Dorian against the breath. Wyrmling took 9 force from me, so keep pressing it with non-fire damage!
Pulling back to stay out of breath range. I'll keep force and cold damage on the wyrmling next round. No fire!
I'm spread out and clear of breath range. Next round I'm putting cold and force on the wyrmling. Dorian, shout if you drop and I'll come back for you.
Flanking the wyrmling now. Piercing steel incoming, no fire. Dorian, hang on!
Shortsword into the wyrmling with Sneak Attack, Aldric. Vex gives me advantage on the follow-up. Dagger next!
Dagger follow-up into the wyrmling with Advantage. It's bloodied, so keep piling on, everyone!
I'm holding the southeast flank, opposite Dorian, so the wyrmling can't breathe on both of us. Lyra, put force or cold on it. It's bloodied, so finish it!
Dorian's gone. Make it count! Greatsword on the bloodied wyrmling. Kaelen, stay spread out, and Lyra, force or cold on it!
Second swing on the wyrmling. It's bloodied, so keep the non-fire damage coming and we drop it this round!
Graze got 4 more onto the wyrmling. I'm holding the line here. Kaelen, Lyra: non-fire damage on the bloodied wyrmling to finish it!
Five force darts into the wyrmling, all of them! Aldric, Kaelen, if it's still standing, hit it again, then we turn on the hounds.
I'm out of actions this turn, so I'm falling back to stay clear of the breath. Aldric, Kaelen, finish the wyrmling. It's on its last legs!
Holding back here at range. If the wyrmling's still up next round it eats cold or force from me; otherwise I'm switching to the hounds. No fire on any of them!
Wyrmling's almost done. Sneak Attack shortsword to finish it! I'm at 5 HP, so Aldric, keep those hounds busy.
Dagger off-hand into the wyrmling. Drop, you overgrown lizard! Aldric, the hounds are next.
I'm tapped out and barely standing. Aldric, Lyra, the wyrmling is critical, so finish it before its breath recharges!
Wyrmling's on its last breath, and I'm finishing it! Lyra, after this, get to Kaelen or cover him from those hounds.
Wyrmling's dead! I'm on the hounds now and sapping this one so it fumbles its next bite. Lyra, Kaelen is down at 15,20. Get him up or cover him, and no fire on these dogs!
I'm tapped out but holding these hounds here. The first one is sapped. Lyra, Kaelen's down at 15,20. Get him up if you can, and no fire on these dogs!
